title: upgrade-attn-flashattnv2-rope-fused-ops-kv-batching-scheduling
author: Ava Kumar
description: Motivation: upgrade attention kernels to FlashAttentionV2 with fused rotary/rope ops and tighter KV-batching/scheduling integration to reduce token cost and tail latency across long-context workloads. This PR introduces a new kernel set and runtime toggles, integrates fused-rotary and fused-rope codepaths to avoid extra transposes, and reworks the scheduler's batching window to be workload-aware so continuous batching and KV prefetch can cooperate. Scope: kernel upgrades (cuda/cuBlas kernels and assembly), runtime flags and autodetect for GPU capability, scheduler changes to support weighted priority queues and dynamic batching windows, KV cache prefetch hooks, unit+integration tests, and perf benchmarks. Backwards compatibility: fallbacks to legacy kernels on unsupported devices and a runtime flag `enable_flashattnv2` for staged rollouts. Related: ENG-1932 (kernel upgrade), ENG-2018 (scheduler/kv work).
commits_summary: 5 commits: 1) add flashattnv2 kernels and wrapper (driver-level API), 2) implement fused rotary/rope fusion and remove redundant transpose ops, 3) scheduler: dynamic batching windows + weighted priority queue + KV prefetch hook, 4) add runtime flags and GPU capability autodetect, 5) tests, benchmarks, and docs updates.
commits: implement fused rotary/rope fusion and remove transposes
scheduler: dynamic batching windows + weighted priority queue + kv prefetch

files_changed_summary: runtime/attention/flashattnv2_cuda.cu (new kernel implementations), runtime/attention/fused_ops.cpp/h (fusion glue), runtime/scheduler/dynamic_batcher.cpp (new batching policy), runtime/scheduler/priority_queue.h, runtime/kv_cache/prefetcher.cpp (prefetch hooks), runtime/config/runtime_flags.cpp (enable_flashattnv2), tests/attention/flashattn_integration_test.py, benchmarks/attn_throughput_long_context.py, docs/ops/flashattnv2.md, build/CUDA.cmake updates.
performance_summary: Benchmarks (internal synthetic and real workload traces): +1.35x throughput on 8K context for GPT-like models on A100, median token latency down 12% for long tails, memory peak reduced ~9% due to fused ops and elimination of redundant buffers, CPU overhead from KV handling down 25% with prefetch and batched KV dispatch. Small-context (<=512) shows negligible regression (<2%).
backwards_compatibility: Legacy kernels preserved under runtime flag `enable_flashattnv2=false`. Autodetect will disable the new kernels for GPUs without required compute capability or missing CUDA primitives. Migration notes in docs/ops/flashattnv2.md.
